rules.statement: A retracted changed subject fails before closure; candidate or disputed changed subjects seed Unknown, set rootApplicabilityUnknown, and cannot be upgraded by a rule or later edge.
Every declared edge, rule, and duty has an applicability evaluation; a retracted source evaluates FALSE and cannot materialize a path but remains visible in the ledger.
Candidate or disputed source authority uses CANDIDATE_INPUT_NOT_AUTHORITY in predicate evaluation; dependency closure additionally uses CANDIDATE_EDGE_NOT_AUTHORITY on a guarded candidate edge path.

All independent node-simple paths are preserved through maxDepth; an admitted continuation beyond the limit converts the frontier and conservatively reachable residuals to Unknown rather than proving non-impact.

unaffected_proven requires an admitted root, admitted TRUE prefix, admitted FALSE cut, no bypass, complete coverage, decisive evaluation references, and no reachable continuation hidden beyond maxDepth.
A complete-boundary retracted residual node emits an out_of_declared_scope path with origin excluded; candidate, disputed, or uncovered residuals remain Unknown unless OAC-SUP-SEM-005 is satisfied.

Legacy per-target discovery uses obligationType discover_dependency and requiredEvidence dependency_admission_decision; contextual aggregate discovery uses its explicit target, type, and evidence triple.
A partial or unknown completeness manifest with no known gap and no explicit discovery target emits urn:oac:boundary:unobserved as its implicit gap target.
unresolvedRefs contains emitted Unknown paths, Unknown evaluations referenced by emitted paths, and the change ID for an Unknown root; unrelated Unknown evaluations remain ledger-only.
An admitted UnknownTransitionDuty that evaluates UNKNOWN without an admitted target and required role fails UNKNOWN_TRANSITION_DUTY_INVALID before prerequisite-order construction.
